title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities We are hiring an Automation Test Engineer with 4+ years of experience to own functional, integration and regression testing of our private cloud platform, built on OpenStack and Ceph. You will design automated test suites, run them continuously against our environments, and help the team ship platform changes with confidence. 
 Key responsibilities Analyse cloud platform features and changes, then write test plans, test scenarios and test cases covering functional, integration, regression and negative paths. Design, build and maintain automated test suites for platform services such as compute (Nova), networking (Neutron/OVN), block and object storage (Cinder, Ceph RBD/RGW), identity (Keystone) and images (Glance). Automate end-to-end workflows: tenant and project onboarding, VM lifecycle, volume attach/detach, snapshots, floating IPs, security groups, load balancers and quota enforcement. Test platform APIs (OpenStack REST APIs, CLI and SDK) and validate responses, error handling and multi-tenant isolation. Execute automated and manual test runs, triage failures, and log clear, reproducible defects with logs and steps. Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines so they run on every build, upgrade and configuration change. Run upgrade, failover and resilience tests, such as controller node loss, Ceph OSD failure and network path failover, and verify the platform recovers as expected. Support performance and scale testing with tools like Rally, and report on latency, throughput and capacity limits. Maintain test environments and test data, and keep the automation framework clean, reusable and documented. Publish test reports and quality metrics (pass rate, coverage, defect trends) to engineering and operations teams.• Work closely with platform, network and storage engineers during sprint planning, release readiness and production change validation. 

 Preferred candidate profile Required skills and qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or equivalent experience. 4+ years of software testing experience, including at least 2 years building test automation from scratch. Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or Java/Go for writing test code. Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Pytest and playwright. Solid API testing experience using REST clients, Postman or code-based API test suites. Working knowledge of cloud or virtualisation platforms: OpenStack, VMware, AWS, Azure or KVM. Good Linux skills: shell scripting, log analysis, systemd services and basic troubleshooting. Understanding of networking basics: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, DNS, DHCP and firewalls. Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or Zuul. Familiarity with containers (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts. Strong grasp of testing fundamentals: test design techniques, STLC, defect lifecycle and test reporting. Experience with a defect and test management tool such as Jira, TestRail or Xray. Clear written and verbal communication for defect reports and test summaries. Preferred skills (nice to have) Direct experience testing OpenStack services, or using OpenStack test tools such as Tempest and Rally. Exposure to Ceph storage (RBD, RGW, CephFS) and its failure and recovery behaviour. Knowledge of software-defined networking: OVS, OVN, VXLAN/Geneve overlays, BGP. Infrastructure-as-code and configuration tools: Ansible, Terraform or Kolla-Ansible. Performance and load testing with Rally, Locust, JMeter or fio. Monitoring and logging stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana or ELK/OpenSearch for test validation. Security and multi-tenancy testing (RBAC, network isolation, policy enforcement). ISTQB or equivalent testing certification; OpenStack (COA) or cloud certifications.

Key Skills: CI Cd Pipeline,Openstack,Shell scripting,Docker,VMware,AWS,JIRA,Continuous Integration
